notes:
**CHR-1257 phase 2b, Stitch chrome (2026-11-27, awaiting Christian's approval).** New project (no project open) as a floating dialog (pattern `float-dialog`) over `no-project-empty-state`. Same folder picker as `open-project-dialog` and the same dialog as `chrome-c-dialog` (opened inside a project). Behaviour unchanged (history below).

- h1 "New project" + sub (`aria-describedby`), close / Cancel / scrim back to the empty state.
- Places chips, `nav` breadcrumbs, `new-folder-btn` (flow to `init-project-dialog-new-folder`), folder tray `role=listbox` with portfolio `selected`.
- `text-field` `empty` "Project name": the placeholder my-new-project in tertiary, hint "Will create: ~/Workspace/portfolio/my-new-project" linked by `aria-describedby`.
- "Create & open" is `confirm-disabled` until a name is typed.

---
Earlier notes (history):

Creating a new project: the same folder browser plus a name field. Confirm stays disabled until both a parent folder and a name are chosen.

CHR-831: the name field is labelled "Project name" (was "New folder / project name") so it is not confused with the new "+ New folder" button in the path row, which creates intermediate folders such as ~/work/clients. States: `init-project-dialog-new-folder` (typing) and its `-exists`, `-invalid`, `-permission`, `-created` variants.
